entries.title: Leviticus 1:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the tabernacle of meeting, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 1:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When any one of you brings an offering to the LORD, you shall bring your offering of the livestock-of the herd and of the flock.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:3
segments: ¶'If his offering [is] a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish; he shall offer it of his own free will at the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:4
segments: 'Then he shall put his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:5
segments: 'He shall kill the bull before the LORD; and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood and sprinkle the blood all around on the altar that [is by] the door of the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:6
segments: 'And he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:7
segments: 'The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay the wood in order on the fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:8
segments: 'Then the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that [is] on the fire upon the altar;

entries.title: Leviticus 1:9
segments: 'but he shall wash its entrails and its legs with water. And the priest shall burn all on the altar as a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:10
segments: ¶'If his offering [is] of the flocks-of the sheep or of the goats-as a burnt sacrifice, he shall bring a male without blemish.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:11
segments: 'He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD; and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:12
segments: 'And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that [is] on the fire upon the altar;

entries.title: Leviticus 1:13
segments: 'but he shall wash the entrails and the legs with water. Then the priest shall bring [it] all and burn [it] on the altar; it [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:14
segments: 'And if the burnt sacrifice of his offering to the LORD [is] of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:15
segments: 'The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off its head, and burn [it] on the altar; its blood shall be drained out at the side of the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:16
segments: 'And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and cast it beside the altar on the east side, into the place for ashes.

entries.title: Leviticus 1:17
segments: 'Then he shall split it at its wings, [but] shall not divide [it] completely; and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that [is] on the fire. It [is]  a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.
